summary: Prevent browser-check startup from blocking on small Darwin pipes

replay.detail: No durable data or replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No storage or wire version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The browser-check launcher preserves PATH filtering while streaming its input from a concurrent producer instead of synchronously filling a pipe before a reader starts.

downtime.detail: Only the verification launcher changes; running applications are unaffected.

recovery.detail: Revert the launcher change to restore its previous implementation; stored data is unaffected.
